Noah Singh: FYI Helios Labs wants an EU preview in our Dublin node next Thursday. NDA signed, but customs paperwork needs to say 'temporary tech demo'. Can ops confirm temporary import process for Ireland?
Eva Müller: I checked with legal 6; 'temporary tech demo' is okay. We need return-shipment paperwork and an itemized commercial invoice with serials and declared value. I'll attach the template after this thread.
Diego Alvarez: Logistics: FedEx Intl Priority, AWB 1234 5678 9012. ETA Thu 10:30 local. Helios will ship two chassis: HL-RTX-A and HL-RTX-B. Please confirm rack space (2U each) and redundant PDUs.
Hannah Park: Ops note: reserved rack slots 42U-43U, locked cabinet. PDUs: dual feeds available. Need per-chassis max draw; also confirm whether they need DHCP or static IPs.
Noah Singh: Per-chassis draw ~720W sustained, burst 950W. Helios requested static IPs and a dedicated jumpbox with recorded sessions. They've accepted our session recording policy under NDA.
Eva Müller: Data/privacy reminder: recorded sessions must exclude customer-uploaded prompt data. Legal requires we run redaction and store session artifacts in a customer-scoped bucket with access logging.
Diego Alvarez: Ops runbook (brief): boot -> network -> sanity -> rprofile run -> perf sweep -> collect telemetry -> pack artifacts. Example commands to run on the jumpbox:
``
ssh jump@dublin-jumpbox.internal
sudo systemctl start hw-preview.service
latency_probe --nodes HL-RTX-A,HL-RTX-B --seq 4096 --concurrency 2 --out /var/tmp/helios_run.json
```
Hannah Park: I'll pre-create accounts on the jumpbox with 24h TTL. infra-bot: create ephemeral creds for sftp and kube access?
infra-bot: Ephemeral creds request acknowledged. SFTP creds will be generated with 24h TTL; kube tokens scoped to namespace `partners-helios-preview` and expire after 36h.
Diego Alvarez: Telemetry: use the telemetry collector v2, endpoint `https://telemetry.redwood.ai/eu-preview/helios`. Note: KMS key must be customer-scoped with no external export.
Eva Müller: Compliance: we need to confirm KMS policy. Product wants minimal telemetry (cpu/gpu/mem, p50/p95, token counts) and no payloads. Add `--telemetry-minimal` flag to run scripts.
Noah Singh: Also Helios asked for a short benchmark table for press approval (numbers under embargo). We need to coordinate comms: marketing involvement + an embargo date. cc @Marketing later.
Hannah Park: Ops checklist created at `/ops/playbooks/partners/helios-dublin-3087654321.md`. I'll paste final checklist in channel when complete.
Diego Alvarez: Artifact path: s3://partners/helios/preview/3087654321/. Naming: `node-<serial>-3087654321.tgz`. Please ensure scrub step runs before upload: `tools/scrub_personal_data.py`.
Eva Müller: Note: customs label should read 'Temporary exhibition equipment - return guaranteed' per Irish import rules. Also include ATA Carnet if partner requests.
Noah Singh: People: Diego onsite, Hannah remote ops lead, Eva legal on call. I'll join for the final 30-min debrief post-run. Can Diego confirm flight by EOD?
Diego Alvarez: Confirmed 6; I'll post PNR once booked.
infra-bot: Reminder: Dublin lab booking confirmed for 2026-05-12 09:00-17:00.
Hannah Park: Final infra ask: allocate a dedicated VLAN, reserve a /29 for the session, and wire the jumpbox via out-of-band management. Also request that the partner's telemetry endpoint be whitelisted by security.
Noah Singh: Security reminder: no physical media allowed. Helios team will connect via preapproved jumpbox only. Also flag: if any regression >3% on quality eval set, abort and notify product.
Eva Müller: I'll upload the NDA and customs template to s3://partners/helios/docs/countersigned.pdf and s3://partners/helios/docs/customs-template.pdf.
Diego Alvarez: Will ensure container `redwood/helios-preview:2026-05` has `latency_probe` v2.1 and `scrub_personal_data.py`.
Hannah Park: Action items: infra-bot (creds + kube tokens), Diego (container + travel + on-site run), Eva (docs + customs template), Noah (comm + product sync + embargo). Huddle tomorrow 09:30 to validate checklist. :white_check_mark:
